caseName: Herald Publishing Co. v. Whitehead-Donovan Corp.
caseNameFull: HERALD PUBLISHING CO. v. WHITEHEAD-DONOVAN CORP.
attorneys: James G. Butler for appellant., George G. Shapitric for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Harlan is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
